'''Blaeric Negina''' is [[Warder]] to [[Joline Maza]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is a tall [[Shienaran]], with short black hair and blue eyes. His topknot is starting to grow again after being shaved off during his and Joline's time hiding with with [[Valan Luca]]'s circus.

== Activities ==
=== Evading the Seanchan ===
He accompanied Joline to [[Ebou Dar]]. When the [[Seanchan]] attacked, Joline happened to have been dosed with [[Forkroot]]. Along with Joline's other [[Warder]], [[Fen Mizar]], Blaeric managed to sneak Joline out of the [[Tarasin Palace]].

They hide her in the basement of [[The Wandering Woman]]. The owner of the inn, [[Setalle Anan]], recruited [[Matrim Cauthon]] to help Joline escape Ebou Dar. During the escape, Mat had Joline collared to pass as a ''[[damane]]'' until they were out of the city, which neither Joline nor her two Warders were very pleased with.

=== Traveling with the Band ===
Blaeric went with Joline and Mat when they fled Ebou Dar and hid in Valan Luca's circus. He shaved off his topknot.

When [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] managed to get an ''a'dam'' on Joline, Blaeric and Fen damaged the wagon's door and a window in an attempt to aid Joline.

He rode with Mat into the cursed village of [[Hinderstap]] and was attacked by the crazed villagers when nightfall came. He escaped the village with Mat and the others.

After the Band reached [[Caemlyn]], Blaeric left Mat and the Band and journeyed back to the [[White Tower]] with Joline and Fen.
